item.title: The Black Moms Fair 2026 Tour Kicks Off April 18 in the DMV, Featuring Actress and Maternal Health Advocate Tatyana Ali
item.description: The Black Moms Fair is a national movement empowering Black mothers with resources, conversations, and support for maternal health and wellness.

item.title: Megan Thee Stallion and John Legend Headed to New York Stages
item.description: Megan Thee Stallion and John Legend showcase their talents in musical theatre in NYC. Megan debuts in 'Moulin Rouge,' John writes for 'Imitation of Life.'

item.title: Broadway Productions Will Light Up The National in D.C.
item.description: Broadway at The National announces an exciting lineup for its 2026-2027 season, including blockbuster favorites and new premieres. Season ticket sales have begun.

item.title: Explore the Roots of a Civil Rights Icon in D.C. Premiere of 'Young John Lewis: Prodigy of Protest'
item.description: Discover the inspiring journey of civil rights icon John Lewis in the musical 'Young John Lewis: Prodigy of Protest,' running in D.C.

item.title: ICE Detentions Surge, Leaving 11,000 U.S. Citizen Children Without Parents
item.description: Federal immigration authorities detained parents of over 11,000 U.S. citizen children under Trump, leaving families in turmoil and raising concerns.

item.title: Top 10 Happiest Countries: World Happiness Report Points to Social Media, Isolation, and Trust Gaps
item.description: Discover the latest World Happiness Report findings on global well-being, social media's impact on youth, and the happiest countries in the world.

item.title: City Cruises and OCTFME Celebrate District Culture with Capital Sound Series
item.description: Celebrate D.C. culture and the spring equinox aboard the Odyssey with the Capital Sound Series, showcasing local artists and the city's beauty.

item.title: Black Press Week: Tradition, Technology, Rising Talent
item.description: Black Press Day 2026 at Howard University celebrates 199 years of the Black Press, highlighting excellence, legacy, and truth-telling.

item.title: TILGHMAN: The Real Work Begins After the IEP Meeting
item.description: Discover the challenges faced by parents of autistic children when following up on legally binding plans. A call for a system that keeps its promises.

item.title: What's Really Driving Energy Costs: Pepco Points to Causes and Solutions
item.description: Discover why energy bills in Washington, D.C. are rising and learn about the relief efforts Pepco is providing to help customers manage the costs.

item.title: Washington Performing Arts Celebrates 60 Years, Highlights Transformational Power of Supporting Artists
item.description: Washington Performing Arts celebrated its 60th anniversary with a gala showcasing the power of the arts in uniting and transforming lives.
